name: Markdown Plugin
description: Tabbed markdown preview viewer. Renders .md files via marked.parse() with custom Renderer: sanitizes HTML (escape < > in raw HTML blocks), blocks javascript: links, and supports breaks:true. Multi-tab with per-tab scroll position tracking. External file change detection via fs:onChanged — auto-reloads preview preserving scroll position. Drag-and-drop tab reorder. Tab context menu: Close, Close Others, Close All, Copy File Path. Middle-click tab close. Handles empty files ('Empty file'), deleted files ('File deleted'), and render errors gracefully. State serialization: openFiles[], activeFile, scrollTops. Supports legacy single-file format restore (loadedFile + scrollTop).

methods.name: loadFile
methods.description: Read .md file, add tab, switch to preview

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Serialize tabs, active file, and scroll positions

methods.name: restoreState
methods.description: Restore all tabs and active preview (handles legacy format)

state.description: Serialized as part of PluginEntry.markdownState in window.json

fields.name: openFiles
fields.description: Absolute paths of open markdown tabs

lifecycle.destroyed_by: Card close (destroy called, then removed from markdownPlugins array)
